name: loom
description: Narrated Loom-style demo videos: Claude plans and performs the demo in a real browser, Fish Audio speaks it in your cloned voice, FFmpeg renders a captioned 1080p MP4.

fish_reference_id.title: Fish Audio voice model ID
fish_reference_id.description: ID of YOUR cloned voice model on fish.audio (open the model page; the ID is in the URL). Only use a voice you own or have permission to use.

fish_api_key.title: Fish Audio API key
fish_api_key.description: From fish.audio → Developers → API keys. Leave blank if FISH_API_KEY is already set in your environment.

fish_model.title: Fish Audio speech model
fish_model.description: s2.1-pro (paid API credit) or s2.1-pro-free (free developer tier).
